sds-scroll-roll-in.description: Element slides in from the left while rotating into place.

sds-scroll-rise-right.description: Element rises diagonally from the lower-left while fading in.

sds-scroll-cinematic.description: Letterbox bars open outward from the center as the element reveals.

sds-scroll-kaboom.description: Element explodes into view from zero scale with an overshoot pop.

sds-scroll-lean.description: Element leans in from the right in perspective then snaps upright.

sds-scroll-peel.description: Element peels upward from its bottom edge like a sticker lifting.

sds-scroll-stretch.description: Element stretches out from a narrow vertical sliver to full width.

sds-scroll-jello.description: Element bounces in with a wobbly jello-like scale and skew oscillation.

sds-scroll-flip-up.description: Element hinges open from its bottom edge like a trap door swinging up.

sds-scroll-door-left.description: Element swings open from its left edge like a door on a left hinge.

sds-scroll-door-right.description: Element swings open from its right edge like a door on a right hinge.

sds-scroll-barrel.description: Element tumbles in with a diagonal barrel-roll 3D rotation.

sds-scroll-saturate.description: Element transitions from grayscale to full color while fading in.

sds-scroll-sepia.description: Element transitions from sepia tone to full color while fading in.

sds-scroll-overexpose.description: Element burns in from an overexposed flash to natural brightness.

sds-scroll-thermal.description: Element resolves from a thermal hue-shift and high saturation to natural color.

sds-scroll-iris.description: A circular iris expands from the center to reveal the element.

sds-scroll-wipe-up.description: Element is revealed by a clip-path that wipes upward from the bottom.

sds-scroll-wipe-right.description: Element is revealed by a clip-path that wipes across from left to right.

sds-scroll-drop-in.description: Element drops from above and bounces into its final position.

sds-scroll-float.description: Drifts up 6px with a soft blur dissolve — weightless and ethereal.

sds-scroll-sink.description: Settles gently downward from above while fading in.

sds-scroll-shudder.description: Shakes horizontally on entry then vibrates to a stop.

sds-scroll-spin-y.description: Spins in with a 180° rotateY perspective rotation.

sds-scroll-rubber-band.description: Squashes and stretches into place with rubber-band physics.

sds-scroll-stagger-fade.description: Children fade in one by one in a staggered sequence.

sds-scroll-stagger-rise.description: Children rise up and fade in one by one in sequence.

sds-scroll-glare.description: Element burns in from a bright overexposed glare to natural.

sds-scroll-skid-in.description: Slides in fast from the right, overshoots, and brakes.

sds-scroll-slingshot.description: Compressed from the left then launched forward with elastic overshoot.

sds-scroll-blink-in.description: Opacity steps up through four discrete levels like a screen powering on.

sds-scroll-stagger-slide.description: Children slide in from the left one by one in a staggered sequence.

sds-scroll-neon-pop.description: Scales in with a burst of neon drop-shadow glow that settles.

sds-scroll-pixel-in.description: Resolves from a heavy blur and slight zoom to sharp full detail.

sds-scroll-tidal.description: Slides in from the left with a wave-like settling oscillation.

sds-scroll-materialize.description: Steps through four discrete opacity and blur levels like materializing digitally.

sds-scroll-exhale.description: Gently scales down from 112% while fading in — like a slow exhale.

sds-scroll-typewriter.description: Reveals in discrete steps from left to right like a typewriter printing.

sds-scroll-glitch-in.description: Tears in through glitch artifacts — hue shifts, clip flickers, and X displacement.

sds-scroll-unfurl.description: Unrolls from the top-left corner with a gentle rotate and scale.

sds-scroll-pop-in.description: Snaps from zero to overshoot then settles with a springy multi-step pop.

sds-scroll-contrast-in.description: Emerges from high-contrast darkness into natural color and brightness.

sds-spring-drop.description: Letters fall under gravity and bounce off a floor, each landing squashing with its impact speed

sds-orbit-decay.description: Letters spiral inward under drag with conserved angular momentum, spinning faster as they close in

sds-chain-swing.description: Letters swing as damped pendulums, released in sequence so a wave travels along the word

sds-toss-in.description: Letters are thrown in along ballistic arcs, land, bounce and settle

sds-band-snap.description: A stretched rubber-band word snaps back on a mass-spring, overshoots and rings down

sds-split-halves.description: Two halves collide at speed, rebound with restitution and lock together

sds-strike-swap.description: A word is struck out and knocked off to fall under gravity while its replacement drops in on a spring

sds-count-roll.description: Odometer digits roll on springs, overshoot slightly and blur with speed

sds-extrude-rise.description: Text tilts up on a spring while a 3D extrusion grows with the same overshoot

sds-bubble-rise.description: Letters rise like bubbles: buoyancy against drag, a surface overshoot and a growing-then-decaying sway

sds-wind-drift.description: Letters are blown in by a gust: drag eases them to rest while damped flutter and tilt die out

sds-liquid-slosh.description: Outlined text fills like a glass, with the liquid surface sloshing as it settles

sds-gravity-collapse.description: Letters fall in from every direction through an inverse-square field, then flash and ring on arrival

sds-x-text-scrub.description: Words light up one by one as you scroll past the paragraph.

sds-x-text-wave.description: Letters rise into place in a wave with a small overshoot when the text scrolls into view.

sds-x-text-mask.description: Words slide up out of an invisible mask, one after another.

sds-x-text-scramble.description: The text decodes out of random characters, left to right.

sds-x-text-count.description: A number counts up to the value in data-sds-to when it scrolls into view.

sds-x-text-marquee.description: A seamless, endless ticker of text.

sds-x-text-typewriter.description: The text types itself out, letter by letter, with a blinking caret.

sds-x-text-cycle.description: Cycles through a list of words, each sliding and blurring into the next.

sds-x-text-blur.description: Letters sharpen out of a heavy blur one after another.

sds-x-text-drop.description: Letters fall from above and bounce into place, starting from the middle of the line.

sds-x-text-sweep.description: A bright band of colour sweeps through the letters on a loop.

sds-x-text-flip.description: Letters flip up around their base in 3D, in a random order.

sds-x-text-highlight.description: A marker highlight is drawn behind each word, one by one.

sds-x-text-glitch.description: A short red and cyan glitch jolts the text now and then.

sds-x-text-skew.description: The text leans one way or the other depending on how fast you scroll.

sds-x-text-circle.description: Letters are set on a circle that turns slowly.

sds-x-card-tilt.description: The card tilts in 3D towards the pointer and springs back when it leaves.

sds-x-card-magnetic.description: The card is pulled towards the pointer and snaps back with an elastic bounce.

sds-x-card-spotlight.description: A soft spotlight follows the pointer across the card surface.

sds-x-card-fan.description: A pile of cards fans out like a hand of playing cards when it scrolls into view.

sds-x-card-depth.description: The layers inside the card shift by different amounts as the pointer moves, for a sense of depth.

sds-x-card-deck.description: A deck of cards: click the top card and it flies off to the back of the pile.

sds-x-card-carousel.description: Cards sit on a turning 3D ring that speeds up and slows down with the pointer.

sds-x-card-shuffle.description: Click the group and the cards glide to new random positions.

sds-x-card-dim.description: The card under the pointer grows while its neighbours dim and blur.

sds-x-loader-orbit.description: Three dots orbit a centre point, each with its own eased rhythm.

sds-x-loader-chase.description: Three dots bounce in a chase, one after another.

sds-x-loader-equalizer.description: Five bars bounce like an audio equalizer, each at its own random pace.

sds-x-loader-elastic.description: A ring spins with an elastic snap and breathes in and out.

sds-x-loader-blob.description: A blob squashes and stretches as it wobbles.

sds-x-loader-pendulum.description: Five balls swing like a Newton's cradle.

sds-x-loader-dash.description: A circle draws and erases itself as it spins.

sds-x-loader-clock.description: Clock hands sweep around a dial at different speeds.

sds-x-loader-steps.description: A progress bar fills in believable steps, then starts over.

sds-x-loader-bounce.description: A ball bounces with a squash on landing, and its shadow shrinks as it rises.

sds-x-loader-radar.description: A radar sweep turns round and blips appear as it passes.

sds-x-scroll-pin.description: The section stays pinned on screen while you scroll through its length.

sds-x-scroll-parallax.description: The element drifts slower or faster than the page as you scroll.

sds-x-scroll-horizontal.description: The section pins and its row of panels slides sideways as you scroll down.

sds-x-scroll-stagger.description: Child elements rise into place in a staggered batch as they enter the viewport.

sds-x-scroll-zoom.description: The element grows from a smaller size to full size as it scrolls up the screen.

sds-x-scroll-progress.description: A bar at the top of the page fills as you read down the document.

sds-x-scroll-stack.description: Sections stick one on top of another as they reach the top, each shrinking a little as the next arrives.

sds-x-scroll-curtain.description: A curtain opens from the middle outward, revealing the element as it scrolls up.

sds-x-scroll-rotate.description: The element turns as you scroll, by as many full turns as you set.

sds-x-scroll-color.description: The background and text colour blend from one pair to another as the section scrolls into place.

sds-x-scroll-snap.description: Scrolling snaps from one section to the next, with an eased glide.

sds-x-scroll-slides.description: The block pins and its slides cross-fade one after another as you scroll.
